title: Policy Fee Return on HomeFlood Cancellations
content:
**Rule.** When a HomeFlood Private Residential Flood Policies policy is cancelled on the named insured's signed request, part of the tier's policy fee of 35 USD may be added back to the cancellation credit, according to when the request takes effect.

| Request's effective date | Policy-fee return |
|---|---|
| fewer than 30 days after the term start | all of the policy fee, 35.00 |
| 30 days or more after the term start, leaving at least 2 whole months of the term | 50 percent of the policy fee, 17.50 |
| leaving fewer than 2 whole months of the term | none |

Days are counted in calendar days from the term start to the request's effective date. The months left are whole calendar months from the request's effective date to the term end. A count of whole calendar months runs from the earlier date to the later one; the last month is not counted when the later date's day of the month falls before the earlier date's day of the month.

**Installment fees.** Installment fees stay fully earned in the cancellation credit; no part of them is added back to it.

## Boundary cases (term starting 1 March, ending 1 March next year)

| Request effective | Return |
|---|---|
| 30 March (29 days after the start) | 35.00 |
| 31 March (30 days after the start) | 17.50 |
| 1 January (2 whole months left) | 17.50 |
| 2 January (1 whole month left) | none |
